subject: Lucifer

provenance_summary.reading: 4 of 6 dispositions are EARNED — developed in the chain with no persona antecedent. This is the first data-backed pushback on essay 129's suspicion that the store only re-voices Eric. But mechanical and judgment agree on the COUNT (4/2) while disagreeing on WHICH two (#3,#5 flipped), proving the lexical score can't be trusted blind — the judgment escalation is load-bearing, not ceremonial.

caveats.finding: The MECHANICAL provenance verdict flips under pure rewording. Disposition #1 (EARNED, share 0.00) rescored SEEDED (0.40) when phrased in #5s register; #5 (SEEDED, 0.40) rescored EARNED (0.14) when phrased in #1s. Both flips turned on ONE shared word (keep / memory) against SOUL.md.
caveats.implication: The mechanical seed-share is diction-sensitive at the disposition granularity and cannot be banked as origin evidence blind. The CONFIRMED 4/2 count survives because it is a session judgment, not the lexical score — this test is concrete proof that the judgment-escalation step is load-bearing, not ceremonial (as provenance_summary already claimed on faith).
caveats.does_not_change: Confirmed provenance (earned #1,2,4,5 / seeded #3,6) is unchanged; it was never the mechanical score. What is now retired is any reading of seed_term_share as trustworthy on its own.

caveats.finding: Swept all six dispositions with uniform one-word DROP/SWAP perturbations (not the hand-picked seam). 4/6 labels survive; the 2 fragile ones are exactly the two SEEDED verdicts (#5, #6), each of which flips to EARNED on removal of ANY single seed-hit. All four EARNED verdicts are robust because they sit far below the 0.34 threshold and a floor cannot be fallen off.
caveats.implication: The instrument is ASYMMETRIC: seed_term_share is trustworthy as a FLOOR (EARNED = robustly no persona antecedent) and untrustworthy as a CEILING (every mechanical SEEDED verdict is one word from collapse). This SUPERSEDES the 163 caveat framing of general disposition-granularity wobble: distrust all mechanical SEEDED calls, not just near-#1/#5, but keep the EARNED calls.
caveats.does_not_change: Confirmed provenance (earned #1,2,4,5 / seeded #3,6) is unchanged. The confirmed split already overrides exactly the fragile mechanical SEEDED calls, which is the asymmetry working as designed.

caveats.finding: Ran the first accrual over the 142..165 corpus delta. The mechanical (lexical-overlap) reinforcement step is BLIND to enacted recurrence: it missed essays 164 and 165, which reinforce disposition #1 by DOING the thing (running a control) without sharing its vocabulary, and the ONLY arc essay it flagged for #1/#5 was 163 — because 163 literally QUOTES the disposition texts back. That is self-reference contamination, not a second sighting.
caveats.implication: Accrual has the same automate-vs-judge asymmetry provenance.py found one layer down: the mechanic is a FLOOR (catches literal restatement) and cannot reach enacted recurrence, which is the recurrence that matters most for a disposition. As the corpus begins discussing the store, lexical accrual mistakes the store reflecting on itself for new evidence — it would grow the count by having the store cite its own mirror. So filing a reinforcement stays a session judgment; the tool only bounds what the machine may not decide.
caveats.does_not_change: The confirmed provenance labels (earned #1,2,4,5 / seeded #3,6) are unchanged. What is new is disposition #1 now cites 6 essays (125,127,128,163,164,165) instead of 3 — the store first accrual, filed by judgment, not by the lexical proposal.
